We have a target molecule SMILES with atom mapping. The template 1914384 is a retrosynthetic template (retro_smarts_template). The check indicated that the template does NOT match the target (False). However, we need to propose a retrosynthesis route using that template in this order. Possibly we need to apply the template to the target to get precursors. Since check returned false, maybe the template is forward direction? The template's retro_smarts_template is given: '[C:8]-[C@@H;D3;+0:9](-[C@H;D3;+0:10](-[C;D1;H3:11])-[c:12])-[C@;H0;D4;+0:2](-[C:1])(-[OH;D1;+0:3])-[C:4](-[F;D1;H0:5])(-[F;D1;H0:6])(-[F;D1;H0:7])>>[C:1]-[C;H0;D3;+0:2](=[O;H0;D1;+0:3])-[C:4](-[F;D1;H0:5])(-[F;D1;H0:6])(-[F;D1;H0:7]).[C:8]/[CH;D2;+0:9]=[C;H0;D3;+0:10](/[C;D1;H3:11])-[c:12]'

So retro direction: left side (product) -> right side (reactants). The left side is the target? The left side pattern includes a carbon chain with OH and CF3 etc. Our target SMILES: [CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]

Mapping numbers differ: target has mapping 1-18. Template uses mapping 1-14 etc. Might need to map accordingly. The check returned false maybe because mapping mismatched. Could try applying template using apply_template tool.
